links.outcome: Barriers to AI adoption perceived by allied health professionals, including AI knowledge
links.effect: Twenty-four barriers and 24 enablers were identified by 25 participants across four focus groups; lack of AI knowledge was among the barriers, and AI training and education was among the enablers.
links.quote: Barriers included: lack of AI knowledge, explainability challenges, risk to professional practice, negative impact on professional practice, and role replacement.

screen.reason: Qualitative study exploring allied health professionals' perspectives, barriers, and enablers regarding AI implementation in healthcare.
